description: Provenance manifest for all REDACTS knowledge data sources

cwe_database.name: CWE - Common Weakness Enumeration
cwe_database.attribution: CWE is sponsored by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) and managed by the Homeland Security Systems Engineering and Development Institute (HSSEDI) operated by The MITRE Corporation.
cwe_database.notes: Downloaded as ZIP, extracted to data/cwec_v{version}.csv

attack_enterprise.name: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise
attack_enterprise.attribution: ATT&CK is a registered trademark of The MITRE Corporation.
attack_enterprise.notes: ~25MB STIX bundle downloaded on first run or explicit update

yara_php_malware_finder.name: php-malware-finder YARA rules
yara_php_malware_finder.notes: Repository archived Feb 2024. Last tagged release: 0.3.5 (Jan 2018). master branch has later commits.

yara_signature_base_webshells.name: signature-base webshell rules (gen_webshells.yar)
yara_signature_base_webshells.attribution: Rule author attribution must be retained in match messages per DRL 1.1 requirements.
yara_signature_base_webshells.notes: License changed from CC-BY-NC-4.0 to DRL 1.1. DRL requires retaining author field in match output.

yara_signature_base_php_webshells.name: signature-base PHP webshell rules (thor-webshells.yar)
yara_signature_base_php_webshells.attribution: Rule author attribution must be retained in match messages per DRL 1.1 requirements.
yara_signature_base_php_webshells.notes: License changed from CC-BY-NC-4.0 to DRL 1.1. DRL requires retaining author field in match output.

nvd_api.name: National Vulnerability Database (NVD)
nvd_api.attribution: NVD data is produced by NIST and is in the public domain per 17 U.S.C. Sec. 105.
nvd_api.notes: Optional enrichment. Requires API key (REDACTS_NVD_API_KEY env var) for higher rate limits. SQLite cache with 7-day TTL.

redacts_attack_vectors.name: REDACTS Attack Vector Database
redacts_attack_vectors.notes: First-party data, versioned with REDACTS. 34 attack vectors in 7 categories.

redacts_ioc_database.name: REDACTS IoC Database
redacts_ioc_database.notes: First-party data, versioned with REDACTS. 17 IoC indicators.

redacts_infinitered_campaign.name: INFINITERED Campaign Intelligence
redacts_infinitered_campaign.notes: First-party threat intelligence. Static reference data for INFINITERED campaign (Dec 2025 - Feb 2026).

redacts_sensitive_data_patterns.name: REDACTS PHI/PII Detection Patterns
redacts_sensitive_data_patterns.notes: First-party data with HIPAA identifier references. 25 detection patterns.

redacts_mitre_mapping.name: REDACTS MITRE ATT&CK / CVSS / CWE Mapping
redacts_mitre_mapping.attribution: Copyright 2024-2026 The Adimension / Shehab Anwer. Mappings reference ATT&CK v14+, CWE v4.13+, CVSS v3.1.
redacts_mitre_mapping.notes: First-party mapping data linking detection rules to ATT&CK techniques, CWE IDs, and CVSS vectors.
